title: Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Cleaning in Abuja: The Host's Guide to 5-Star Reviews
excerpt: Professional Airbnb cleaning in Abuja. Fast turnover service, hotel-quality standards & restocking. Keep your 5-star rating. Book your reliable cleaning team today!

children.text: Professional turnover cleaning is the difference between 5-star reviews and costly cancellations. In Abuja's competitive short-term rental market, cleanliness is your #1 ranking factor.

Travelers rank cleanliness as the #1 factor when booking vacation rentals. One missed hair in the bathroom or dusty surface can drop your 5-star rating to 3 stars—costing you thousands in lost bookings. Professional turnover cleaning isn't an expense; it's revenue protection.

Turnover cleaning is a specialized, time-sensitive service designed specifically for short-term rentals. It requires a complete reset to hotel standards before the next guest arrives, often within a tight 2-4 hour window.
The Serenity.ng Airbnb Cleaning System: 5-Star Guarantee
Our team follows a rigorous 3-phase system: Rapid Assessment (damage report), Deep Cleaning (HEPA vacuuming and sanitization), and Hotel Finishing (linen setup and restocking).
